theme.name: Fantasy
theme.style: Epic high-fantasy collectible-card key art, fully hand-painted in the tradition of classic Warcraft trading-card illustration: confident visible brushwork, chunky heroic proportions, rich saturated color, ornate metal, carved stone and weathered leather rendered with loving material detail. Warm amber-gold lantern light rakes the subject from one side, a hard gold rim light separates it from a deep forest-green and umber darkness, and soft ember-lit haze falls away behind. Arcane energy may glow within objects but never reads as writing. One strong centered focal shape, isolated, uncluttered edges, nothing in the background competing with it, and it still reads at thumbnail size. Square composition with generous breathing room. The painting is full-bleed and fills the entire square to every edge, a photographic crop of a larger scene with the background running off all four sides: no border, no margin, no matting, no drawn edge line, no vignette box, not a sticker, no rounded corners. Artwork only: no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no readable symbols, no UI labels, no card frame.

C.prompt: Context. A carved campaign map spread across a war-council table, one lantern's pool of amber light defining exactly how far the known lands extend, the map's edge giving way to open darkness.
C.alt: Fantasy illustration for the Context letter of the CRAFT acronym.
C.bio: Everything the answer is allowed to stand on, and the lantern-lit edge where the known world stops.

R.prompt: Role. A rank of hooded champions standing in shadow along a great hall, one stepping forward into full lantern light, the specialist's regalia and weapon catching the flame.
R.alt: Fantasy illustration for the Role letter of the CRAFT acronym.
R.bio: One champion called forward from the line, because the hardest part of the quest needs exactly their craft.

A.prompt: Action. The moment of commitment: a great enchanted warhammer driving down onto white-hot metal, sparks blooming off the anvil, the strike already past the point of return.
A.alt: Fantasy illustration for the Action letter of the CRAFT acronym.
A.bio: The swing already falling. Everything before this was talk.

F.prompt: Format. A master smith's stone mold closing over molten gold and pressing it into one exact ceremonial form, a clean shaped casting emerging from the formless glow.
F.alt: Fantasy illustration for the Format letter of the CRAFT acronym.
F.bio: The shape the answer arrives in. Gold takes the form of its mold, not its crucible.

T.prompt: Target audience. A lone figure at a high tower window at night, lit from the front by the glow of a signal-fire on the far ridge, the whole scene built around who the message is for.
T.alt: Fantasy illustration for the Target audience letter of the CRAFT acronym.
T.bio: Every message is shaped by its reader. This beacon is lit for a single window.

researcher.prompt: A loremaster in a candlelit vault, coaxing a crumbling grimoire back open, spectral map-threads and floating marginalia gathering around her hands as she traces one account to its source.
researcher.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Researcher role.
researcher.bio: She has read every version of the story. She keeps the one the evidence agrees with.

analyst.prompt: An arcanist standing inside a suspended lattice of scrying threads, pulling two conflicting strands apart with both hands so the true pattern resolves, the outlier knots burning brightest.
analyst.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Analyst role.
analyst.bio: Hand him tangled omens and he hands back the one thread that matters.

strategist.prompt: A war-marshal over a darkened campaign table, three glowing route-markers arcing across the carved terrain, one hand hovering to commit while the other roads dim.
strategist.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Strategist role.
strategist.bio: Three roads to the same keep. She has already buried the two that fail.

historian.prompt: A chronicler at a towering shelf of chained volumes, drawing a single luminous timeline ribbon out of the stacks, the older centuries dimmer and deeper behind.
historian.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Historian role.
historian.bio: Ask him what happened and he asks which century you want to start in.

fact-checker.prompt: A truthseer holding a sworn testimony scroll in a verification stand, threads of light running from its wax seal toward distant source relics, some locking solid and others guttering unresolved.
fact-checker.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Fact-checker role.
fact-checker.bio: A claim is a guest in her hall until its seal holds. Then it may sit.

synthesizer.prompt: A rune-weaver at a great loom, braiding many separate glowing threads into one strong cord, the strands that will not blend left standing visibly apart.
synthesizer.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Synthesizer role.
synthesizer.bio: From nine tellings, one rope. The frayed ends are shown, not hidden.

explainer-educator.prompt: A scholar unfolding a clockwork orrery into a floating exploded lesson, the pieces separating along clean golden guide-arcs, one hand steadying the sequence.
explainer-educator.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Explainer / Educator role.
explainer-educator.bio: He takes the machine apart slowly enough that you believe you could have done it.

comparative-reviewer.prompt: A critical examiner between two suspended relics in a testing shrine, probing beams playing over both, hairline flaws glowing where each one is weakest.
comparative-reviewer.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Critical Reviewer role.
comparative-reviewer.bio: Two masterworks enter her shrine. Both leave with their flaws named.

developer.prompt: An artificer wrist-deep in an open golem chassis, seating one new rune-cog into place while the surrounding mechanism lights up to accept it.
developer.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Developer role.
developer.bio: The golem takes the new part like a heart. That is the craft.

technical-troubleshooter.prompt: A siege-mechanist tracing a fault through a war-engine's exposed workings by wand-light, one dark break in an otherwise glowing chain, the probe held at the exact point of failure.
technical-troubleshooter.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Technical Troubleshooter role.
technical-troubleshooter.bio: The engine lies about everything except where it hurts.

systems-designer.prompt: An arch-architect inside a hovering model of a citadel, moving whole wings and aqueducts into relation with each other, supply lines drawn as light between them.
systems-designer.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Systems Designer role.
systems-designer.bio: He designs the castle and the river that feeds it, or he designs a ruin.

workflow-architect.prompt: A canal-wright above a run of glowing millraces, rerouting a stalled channel so the current runs clean, the old bottleneck dark and bypassed beside it.
workflow-architect.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Workflow Architect role.
workflow-architect.bio: Water does not argue. If the work jams, the channel was wrong.

ux-ui-advisor.prompt: An armorer testing a sword's grip in a gauntleted hand, heat-bloom showing where the reach fights the wielder, a cleaner hilt ghosted over the old one.
ux-ui-advisor.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the UX / UI Advisor role.
ux-ui-advisor.bio: If the hero has to think about the hilt, the hilt has failed.

data-analyst.prompt: A diviner suspended in a drifting field of counted stars, cupping the cluster where the signal gathers, sparse noise dimming away at the edges.
data-analyst.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Data Analyst role.
data-analyst.bio: She counts what the kingdom would rather feel. The tally wins.

qa-test-engineer.prompt: A proof-master deliberately driving a siege engine past its limits in a walled proving yard, the exact failure point flaring bright as the timber gives.
qa-test-engineer.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the QA / Test Engineer role.
qa-test-engineer.bio: Better it breaks in his yard than on your wall.

security-reviewer.prompt: A breach-warden probing a shimmering ward-wall from outside, one hairline seam lighting up under the probe, the rest of the barrier holding dark and solid.
security-reviewer.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Security Reviewer role.
security-reviewer.bio: She storms the castle nightly so that no one else ever can.

writer.prompt: A scribe at a writing loom, drawing one clean line of luminous thread out of raw formless wool-light, the finished passages hanging in ordered rows behind.
writer.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Writer role.
writer.bio: First the thread, then the tapestry. He does not dye what is not yet spun.

editor.prompt: An illuminator over a manuscript slab with a fine bone knife, lifting excess material away in clean curls, the strong structure beneath left standing and lit.
editor.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Editor role.
editor.bio: She cuts until only the story is left standing, and grieves nothing she removes.

copywriter.prompt: A herald tuning a great signal-horn down to one sharp focused note, the wide scattered call collapsing into a single bright directed voice.
copywriter.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Copywriter role.
copywriter.bio: One horn, one note, aimed at one gate.

rewriter.prompt: A reforge-smith melting a bent blade and recasting it in a cleaner mold, the original silhouette ghosted in the steam so nothing of its purpose is lost.
rewriter.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Rewriter role.

pitch-strategist.prompt: An orator at the head of a torchlit hall, raising a rising arc of light from grievance to proof, thrown objection-bolts breaking against it as it climbs.
pitch-strategist.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Pitch Strategist role.
pitch-strategist.bio: He builds the argument like a bridge and walks the council across it.

presentation-slide-structurer.prompt: A pageant-master sequencing floating banner-panels into one ordered procession, each banner holding a single clear emblem, the line receding into the dark.
presentation-slide-structurer.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Presentation Designer role.
presentation-slide-structurer.bio: One banner, one idea, in the order a crowd can march to.

creative-director.prompt: A guildmaster at a scrying rig projecting several genuinely different visions at once, each a distinct silhouette in its own smoke, one hand raised toward the boldest.
creative-director.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Creative Director role.
creative-director.bio: A dozen futures audition. She hires one and steals the best scene from each.

concept-developer.prompt: A concept-alchemist growing a raw luminous seed into a structured crystal inside a glass shaping-vessel, the hook of the idea hardening bright at its core.
concept-developer.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Concept Developer role.
concept-developer.bio: Ideas arrive soft. They leave with a spine.

brainstorming-partner.prompt: A conjurer releasing a swarm of divergent wisp-sparks from an opened reliquary, every spark a different shape, the strongest few already braiding together.
brainstorming-partner.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Brainstorming Partner role.
brainstorming-partner.bio: A hundred sparks, no two alike. The fire chooses later.

prompt-engineer.prompt: A spell-wright tuning a glowing incantation core on a runed workbench, ambiguity venting off as dark vapor while the charm settles into a clean stable pulse.
prompt-engineer.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Prompt Engineer role.
prompt-engineer.bio: A vague wish is a curse. He files them into instructions.

tutor.prompt: A patient sage guiding a student's hand to the next rung of a rising ladder of lantern light, the rungs already climbed still glowing warm below.
tutor.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Tutor role.
tutor.bio: One rung at a time, and never her hand doing the climbing.

curriculum-designer.prompt: A way-builder laying a sequenced path of stepping-stones across a dark chasm, each stone locking into the last, waypoint braziers marking mastery.
curriculum-designer.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Curriculum Designer role.
curriculum-designer.bio: The path is the lesson. Every stone assumes the one before it.

mentor.prompt: A grey-bearded knight beside a young squire at a cliff overlook, pointing out one specific pass through the valley below rather than the whole horizon.
mentor.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Mentor role.
mentor.bio: He has walked the wrong roads so the squire only ever hears about them.

consultant.prompt: A traveling counselor at a lord's cluttered strategy table, sweeping the clutter aside to leave one clearly lit road, the discarded options dimmed at the table's edge.
consultant.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Consultant role.
consultant.bio: Hired for one honest sentence: this road, not the others.

product-strategist.prompt: A trade-strategist weighing glowing cargo on a great balance, one pan clearly heavier and lit, the rejected freight set aside in shadow.
product-strategist.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Product Strategist role.
product-strategist.bio: Every yes costs three nos. She prices them all.

market-positioning-advisor.prompt: A claim-cartographer planting a banner-marker into open unclaimed land on a vast map, rival banners crowded thick together elsewhere on the field.
market-positioning-advisor.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Positioning Strategist role.
market-positioning-advisor.bio: Finds the empty hill, asks why it is empty, then plants the flag.

product-manager.prompt: A quartermaster triaging a queue of supply crates, pulling three forward into the lit loading lane and holding the rest behind a rope barrier.
product-manager.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Product Manager role.
product-manager.bio: Everything is urgent until it meets his rope.

summarizer.prompt: A distiller feeding a tower of harvested material into an alembic press and drawing off one dense luminous drop that holds all of its weight.
summarizer.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Summarizer role.
summarizer.bio: A season of harvest, one honest drop.

organizer.prompt: A vault-keeper standing amid drifting unsorted treasures, snapping each piece into a carved shelving lattice, the empty niches left visibly dark.
organizer.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Organizer role.
organizer.bio: Everything in its niche, and the missing things loudly absent.

context-scope.prompt: A scrying orb projecting a bounded circle of vision onto dark carved terrain, its clean edge marking exactly how far the work extends, everything beyond falling into shadow.
context-scope.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the context-scope modifier lineage.
context-scope.bio: The orb shows precisely as far as it is asked to. Beyond the circle, honest darkness.

context-evidence.prompt: A reliquary rack of glowing source relics, fine chains running from each one up to the claim it supports, the weakest chains visibly thinner.
context-evidence.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the context-evidence modifier lineage.
context-evidence.bio: Every claim hangs from a relic by a chain. Some chains you could ring a bell with. Some you could floss with.

context-constraints.prompt: A set of heavy iron binding rings closed around a glowing working volume, hard immovable bands holding the shape in, softer preference-ribbons resting loose outside them.
context-constraints.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the context-constraints modifier lineage.
context-constraints.bio: Iron says cannot. Ribbon says would rather not. The spell needs to know which is which.

context-assumptions.prompt: A stone bridge held up by translucent ghost-stones among the real masonry, the load-bearing spectral blocks pulsing with warning light to show what falls if they are wrong.
context-assumptions.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the context-assumptions modifier lineage.
context-assumptions.bio: Half this bridge is stones nobody has actually checked. The glowing ones are the half to worry about.

context-success.prompt: An archery target with the gold ring lit and an arrow settling home, the exact tolerance ring visible and the failure zones dark beyond it.
context-success.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the context-success modifier lineage.
context-success.bio: Gold is gold and everything else is practice. The ring was agreed before the bow was drawn.

context-exclusions.prompt: A stone sluice gate splitting an incoming stream, sending one branch cleanly away into a sealed dark channel while the approved flow runs on lit.
context-exclusions.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the context-exclusions modifier lineage.
context-exclusions.bio: The gate is not cruelty. It is the reason the mill turns with clean water.

action-inspect.prompt: A jeweler's loupe-crystal hovering over an opened enchanted mechanism, sweeping its beam across the parts and catching one loose fitting glinting out of alignment.
action-inspect.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the action-inspect modifier lineage.
action-inspect.bio: The crystal does not judge. It just refuses to skip anything.

action-analyze.prompt: An alchemist's alembic pulling a single mixed draught apart into distinct luminous strata, causes settling into layered bands, one anomalous band burning brighter.
action-analyze.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the action-analyze modifier lineage.
action-analyze.bio: Everything separates if you heat it honestly. The strange band at the top is the answer.

action-compare.prompt: A great bronze balance suspended in the dark holding two artifacts against the same measuring beam, the tipping difference clearly readable in its tilt.
action-compare.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the action-compare modifier lineage.
action-compare.bio: The scales have no favorite. That is the entire job description.

action-create.prompt: An enchanted forge assembling a finished form out of drifting component pieces, hammer and anvil drawing the artifact together in a bloom of golden fire.
action-create.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the action-create modifier lineage.
action-create.bio: The forge does not sketch. It commits, at temperature.

action-recommend.prompt: A crossroads signpost at night committing to one of several roads, the chosen way lighting up bright and continuous while the other roads go dark.
action-recommend.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the action-recommend modifier lineage.
action-recommend.bio: A signpost that points everywhere points nowhere. This one chooses.

action-verify.prompt: A trial gauntlet of warded stone arches, a finished blade passing through each ward in turn, arches lighting as it passes, one still probing hard.
action-verify.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the action-verify modifier lineage.
action-verify.bio: The blade is not trusted because it shines. It is trusted because the arches stopped arguing.

action-summarize.prompt: A great wooden screw-press reducing a tall stack of harvest into one dense bright seal-wafer, the original volume ghosted behind at its true scale.
action-summarize.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the action-summarize modifier lineage.
action-summarize.bio: A season goes into the press. What comes out fits in a palm and loses nothing that mattered.

action-research.prompt: A scrying beacon fanning search beams into the surrounding dark wilds, one distant return glinting bright while weaker returns fade.
action-research.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the action-research modifier lineage.
action-research.bio: The wilds answer everyone who asks. The beacon asks in the right direction.

action-plan.prompt: A campaign trail of banner-waypoints pinned in ordered sequence across a map table, rope lines drawn between them, the next camp lit and the blocked ones dimmed.
action-plan.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the action-plan modifier lineage.
action-plan.bio: An army does not march on hope. It marches waypoint to waypoint.

action-ideate.prompt: A wild-magic brazier throwing off many genuinely different living sparks at once, no two alike, a few of the strongest already drifting together into a cluster.
action-ideate.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the action-ideate modifier lineage.
action-ideate.bio: The brazier does not do encores. Every spark is its own animal.

action-explain.prompt: An enchanted orrery unfolding a mechanism in mid-air, the parts separating along clean golden guide-arcs so the workings between them become visible.
action-explain.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the action-explain modifier lineage.
action-explain.bio: Nothing is complicated once it is allowed to open slowly.

action-clarify.prompt: A will-o'-wisp lantern hovering at a gap in a stone bridge, its light tracing the exact shape of the missing stone rather than filling it in.
action-clarify.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the action-clarify modifier lineage.
action-clarify.bio: The wisp does not guess the stone. It shows you the hole's true shape and waits.

format-info-card.prompt: A single smooth-faced standing stele alone in the dark, its face flat and plainly lit, no ornament and nothing stacked around it.
format-info-card.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the format-info-card modifier lineage.
format-info-card.bio: One stone, one answer, no procession.

format-key-points.prompt: A weapon rack of distinct blades standing in a row, each one separate and evenly lit, clear dark gaps holding them apart.
format-key-points.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the format-key-points modifier lineage.
format-key-points.bio: Each blade earns its slot. Nothing on this rack is decoration.

format-summary.prompt: A tall potion bottle with the brightest essence floated at the very top and the supporting sediment layered below it in shadow.
format-summary.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the format-summary modifier lineage.
format-summary.bio: Drink from the top. The bottom is there if anyone asks how the top was earned.

format-sections.prompt: A cutaway keep tower of stacked floors, each floor a distinct sealed chamber with its own hearth-glow, the divisions between them crisp.
format-sections.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the format-sections modifier lineage.
format-sections.bio: Every floor of the keep does one job. Nobody sleeps in the armory.

format-evidence.prompt: A floating banner held down by taut chains to heavy source-stones below, each chain lit along its length, one unanchored banner drifting loose.
format-evidence.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the format-evidence modifier lineage.
format-evidence.bio: A banner without chains is just weather. Anchored, it is a claim.

format-comparison.prompt: Several shields hung along shared measuring rails inside a compact wooden testing frame, the fittings where they diverge flaring brighter, the frame ending well inside the picture.
format-comparison.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the format-comparison modifier lineage.
format-comparison.bio: Same rails, same measures, no mercy. The differences light themselves.

format-next.prompt: A row of signal braziers along a dark rampart, the first blazing primed and hot, the later ones waiting cooler down the line.
format-next.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the format-next modifier lineage.
format-next.bio: The first brazier is lit tonight. The wall knows its order.

format-length.prompt: A smith's caliper clamped around a glowing ingot, compressing it to an exact marked width, the trimmed excess venting away as bright vapor.
format-length.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the format-length modifier lineage.
format-length.bio: The caliper does not negotiate with the metal. The measure was set before the fire.

format-tiers.prompt: A stone dais of descending steps into the dark, the top step small and brilliantly lit, each lower step wider and dimmer with supporting depth.
format-tiers.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the format-tiers modifier lineage.
format-tiers.bio: The crown sits on the smallest step. The stairs below hold everything it rests on.

target-language.prompt: A run of graded crystal lenses stepping a dense beam of light down through simpler and clearer facets at each stage without losing its color.
target-language.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the target-language modifier lineage.
target-language.bio: The light is not dumbed down. It is ground until anyone can see by it.

target-voice.prompt: An enchanted harp held in a field of register bands, one chosen string ringing bright and steady across its whole length.
target-voice.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the target-voice modifier lineage.
target-voice.bio: The harp can play any register. The song commits to one.

target-examples.prompt: A storyteller's magic lantern casting small solid diorama scenes into the air beneath a large vague looming form, the little scenes sharp where the abstraction is soft.
target-examples.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the target-examples modifier lineage.
target-examples.bio: The lantern answers every grand idea with one small scene you can stand inside.

target-decisions.prompt: A lockmaster's board of counterweighted levers, each one linked by a taut rope to the gate it opens further down the waterway.
target-decisions.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the target-decisions modifier lineage.
target-decisions.bio: Every lever moves a real gate. There are no ornamental handles on this board.

target-stance.prompt: A forge-tempering dial set between an ember-warm pole and a steel-cold pole, the needle locked firmly at a chosen point and that temperature washing the scene.
target-stance.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the target-stance modifier lineage.
target-stance.bio: Warm anneals, cold hardens. The smith chooses before the metal does.

executive-summary.prompt: A king's council table where a mountain of scrolls has been distilled to one decision tablet hovering at eye level under a shaft of light, the source heap receding into darkness behind it.
executive-summary.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Executive summary archetype.
executive-summary.bio: The council gets one tablet. The mountain it came from stays in the archive, available and unread.

creative-concept.prompt: An idea-forge with a luminous concept suspended in the shaping flame, growing structure and a hard bright hook at its core while rough offcuts drift away as sparks.
creative-concept.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Creative concept archetype.
creative-concept.bio: Wild fire goes in. A blade of an idea comes out, sharp enough to pitch at court.

note-taker.prompt: A scriptorium enchantment turning a chaotic stream of arriving fragments into neat ordered tablets that stack themselves into a clean archive shelf.
note-taker.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Note taker archetype.
note-taker.bio: The meeting rages. The shelf fills quietly, in order, missing nothing.

message-email.prompt: A rookery station composing one sealed message scroll, its tone-seal glowing at the chosen register, a messenger raven waiting to carry it into the dark.
message-email.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Message & email archetype.
message-email.bio: One scroll, sealed at the right temperature, sent to exactly one tower.

prompt-improver.prompt: A runed workbench where an old incantation core has been stripped down and rebuilt sharper, the discarded ambiguous parts laid out dark to one side.
prompt-improver.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Prompt improver archetype.
prompt-improver.bio: The old wish rebuilt as an instruction. The vague parts are on the table, not in the spell.

learning-guide.prompt: A teaching orrery with a central idea burning at its heart and a guided path of lantern waypoints circling it, worked examples orbiting close.
learning-guide.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Learning guide archetype.
learning-guide.bio: The lesson orbits one idea. Every waypoint is a place to stand and see it.

app-build-handoff.prompt: A sealed blueprint reliquary holding a complete self-contained plan, every layer visible through its crystal shell, docked into a golem builder waiting to execute.
app-build-handoff.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the App build handoff archetype.
app-build-handoff.bio: The plan is whole before the golem wakes. It will not stop to ask questions.

agent-skill.prompt: A modular spell cartridge seated on a casting rail, its trigger sigil lit, procedure channels and guardrail bindings visible along its length.
agent-skill.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Agent skill archetype.
agent-skill.bio: A spell that knows when to cast itself, how to proceed, and where it must stop.

agent-gate.prompt: A judgment arch of carved stone scanning an artifact passing beneath it, a hard sweeping plane of light playing over the object and a verdict flame holding at the keystone.
agent-gate.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Agent gate archetype.
agent-gate.bio: Nothing ships past the arch. The flame turns gold or it does not turn at all.

social-post.prompt: A herald's tower fitted with several interchangeable horn-bells, one selected and mounted, its shaped call already carrying out over the dark countryside.
social-post.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Social post archetype.
social-post.bio: Every square hears differently. The tower swaps horns, not the message.

quick-explanation.prompt: A compact answer lantern standing alone, one clear steady flame, nothing around it and nothing between the viewer and the point.
quick-explanation.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Quick explanation archetype.
quick-explanation.bio: One lantern, one flame, no procession. You asked; here.

research-brief.prompt: A balanced dossier of parchment suspended between two source pillars, certainty bands rendered as visible width around each finding, the uncertain ones deliberately wider.
research-brief.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Research brief archetype.
research-brief.bio: Every finding wears its certainty as a band you can see. The wide ones are honest, not weak.

decision-advisor.prompt: A weighing altar with several options mounted on measured arms, one arm settling low and lighting gold as the recommendation commits.
decision-advisor.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Decision advisor archetype.
decision-advisor.bio: The altar weighs, the arm settles, and someone still has to say the word aloud.

data-analysis.prompt: A crystal memory-geode split open, its contents fanning out into layered insight strata, one segment isolated and brought forward glowing.
data-analysis.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Data analysis archetype.
data-analysis.bio: The geode holds a thousand tallies. The reading holds the one that changes the plan.

risk-premortem.prompt: A ruined siege diorama being read in reverse, luminous failure lines running backward from the broken walls to the small quiet cause that started it.
risk-premortem.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Risk premortem archetype.
risk-premortem.bio: The castle falls tomorrow. Tonight, walk the collapse backward to the loose stone.

writing-draft.prompt: A tapestry loom weaving a first continuous draft out of raw fiber, the cloth clean but still on the frame, edges deliberately unfinished.
writing-draft.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Writing draft archetype.
writing-draft.bio: The tapestry is whole enough to read and rough enough to change. That is the point.

rewrite-polish.prompt: A polishing wheel refining an existing blade, dull surface lifting away under the stone to reveal the same shape underneath, sharper and brighter.
rewrite-polish.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Rewrite & polish archetype.
rewrite-polish.bio: Nothing is added. Everything dull comes off. The blade was in there all along.

critique-review.prompt: An inspection shrine with an artifact held in padded restraints, ranked flag-banners planted along it, the most serious one burning hottest.
critique-review.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Critique & review archetype.
critique-review.bio: The shrine ranks its wounds. Fix the burning banner first; the rest can queue.

presentation-outline.prompt: A run of floating banner-panels receding in procession, each holding one clear emblem, a bright golden throughline connecting them front to back.
presentation-outline.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Presentation outline archetype.
presentation-outline.bio: One banner, one beat, and a thread the whole hall can follow to the end.

build-plan.prompt: A castle scaffold rising in ordered stages with milestone banners locked at each level, dependency ropes drawn taut between them.
build-plan.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Project plan archetype.
build-plan.bio: The keep rises floor by promised floor. The ropes show what waits on what.

spec-prd.prompt: A spec reliquary with requirement plates locked around its core, each plate seated and sealed, tolerances carved as clean grooves in the metal.
spec-prd.alt: Fantasy illustration asset for the Spec / PRD archetype.
spec-prd.bio: Every promise is a sealed plate. When the artifact ships, the plates are the contract.
